artwork.concept: Hero A — THE PMF lime sleeve
artwork.albumReference: The KLF — green 'THE KLF' promo sleeve (The White Room era)
artwork.prompt: Square 1:1 vinyl album sleeve, late-1980s British acid-house graphic design in the style of KLF Communications. Flat fluorescent chartreuse-lime background (#C6FF00). The enormous word 'PMF' in heavy black Helvetica Black condensed capitals, tightly tracked, cropped by the top and bottom edges so it fills the frame. A tiny black word 'THE' sits above the P. At the bottom, one line of heavy black italic condensed capitals: 'IS GONNA ROCK YA!' In the bottom-right corner, a small black circular emblem containing a black pyramid built from a brick wall and a boombox silhouette. Top-right corner, tiny black Helvetica: 'PWV 001'. Along the very bottom edge, tiny black Helvetica credits: 'PRESTON-WERNER VENTURES · PRODUCT · MARKET · FIT'. Slight photocopy grain, halftone dots, subtle vinyl sleeve wear and creases. Severe, minimal, high contrast. Render every quoted text exactly, correctly spelled, crisp and legible. No other text, no real band logos, no signatures.

artwork.concept: Hero B — Ford Timelord / Doctorin' the Tardis
artwork.albumReference: The Timelords — Doctorin' the Tardis (1988)
artwork.prompt: Square 1:1 vinyl single sleeve parody in the style of a 1988 British novelty pop record. Warm cream paper background. Centered three-quarter front photograph of a battered black-and-white 1960s American police car with a single blue roof beacon, chrome bumper, and a white front door panel. On the door, white stencil capitals read 'TO SERVE AND PRODUCT'. A small black-and-white pixel cursor-arrow decal sits on the hood. At the top, small black capitals 'PWV COMMUNICATIONS PRESENT' and then a huge title 'PMF' in heavy white capitals with a hard navy-blue drop shadow and thin navy outline, slightly condensed. Below it, a line of heavy safety-orange italic capitals: 'IS GONNA ROCK YA!'. Lower left, a jagged comic speech bubble with an orange outline and cream fill containing black handwritten marker text: 'Hi! I'm Product Market Fit. I've made a record.' Top right, tiny black Helvetica 'PWV 002'. Slight photocopy grain, halftone, worn paper. Render all quoted text exactly, correctly spelled and legible. No real logos, no signatures.
